findings.summary: Panel uses `children || <EmptyState/>` but children is always a (possibly empty) array from `.map`, and an empty array is truthy in JS, so a section with zero records renders as a blank card instead of showing the intended empty state.
findings.fix: Guard on length instead of truthiness, e.g. accept the mapped items as a prop and render `items.length ? items : <EmptyState .../>`, or check `React.Children.count(children) ? children : <EmptyState .../>` so empty sections show the shared EmptyState.

findings.summary:
The loading state is a bespoke `

جارٍ التحميل…

` rather than the app's shared LoadingScreen or a card/metric skeleton, which is inconsistent with the established loading pattern.
findings.fix: Render the shared LoadingScreen (`if (!q.data) return <LoadingScreen label="جارٍ تحميل القوى العاملة والمالية…"/>`) or a skeleton grid matching the metric/panel layout instead of a plain paragraph.

findings.summary: The error case reuses EmptyState (neutral empty styling) rather than an error/danger-styled banner, so a load failure looks visually identical to a normal 'no data' state.
findings.fix: Use the app's error banner convention (danger tokens: --danger/--danger-soft) or at least pass a distinct error EmptyState variant/action (e.g. retry) so failures read as errors, not emptiness.

findings.summary: PageHeader is given only title/description and omits the `eyebrow`, unlike sibling management pages that use the eyebrow for section context.
findings.fix: Pass an eyebrow such as `eyebrow="الإدارة"` (or the relevant module label) to PageHeader for consistency with other pages.

findings.summary: Panel header font uses raw `font-black` on an `<h2>` without the shared card-header text-size/color tokens used elsewhere, so heading scale may drift from other card sections.
findings.fix: Align the Panel title with the standard card-section heading classes (e.g. `text-base font-black text-[var(--text-primary)]`) used by other panels/cards in the app.

findings.summary: The 'المشاركة والسلف' panel concatenates two independent lists (campaigns then loans) into one flat divided list with no sub-grouping labels, making the two record types visually indistinguishable.
findings.fix: Either split into two Panels, or add a small group label/sub-header (or differing StatusBadge/icon) so campaign rows and loan rows are visually separable.
